entries.prompt: Small source-projection correction of this Ghost mask. Reference2, the WHITE catalog MAIN MASKED FIGURE, is the primary camera/outline authority. Reference1 A has the correct visible sculpt/paint but its large forehead oval is slightly too tall/narrow. Preserve lower cheeks, solid lenses, muzzle length/details and copper side fittings approximately as-is. Make the projected forehead oval a little broader/rounder and about6% less tall, with the whole shell only about3% broader overall; this is a gentle source-camera adjustment, not a squat redesign. The real primary appears mildly downward-pitched and has a rounder crown than reference1. Keep the short top corners, brown-edged horseshoe rim, brow, long muzzle and dark channels exactly source-like, no new features. Do not use the long dramatic scene view as camera authority. Maintain photographed silver/gray and subtle brown/rust, no new grain/etching or recoloring. No dreads, skin, mandibles, neck/collar, body/armor/caster, props/text/backdrop or shadow. One complete rigid mask, genuine transparent alpha. Keep about8–12% clear alpha padding along longest axis. Do not force an arbitrary numeric ratio or straighten source asymmetry; compare crown→eyes→muzzle relationships to catalog. All lens material remains solid.

entries.sourceGenerationPrompt: Create version A, faithful isolated rigid mask of the REAL NECA GHOST Predator SERIES16(2016) photographed collectible edition. Primary reference1 is the official WHITE CATALOG: use the MASK WORN by the LARGE MAIN FIGURE, not the bare pale spotted head in the upper-left inset. Reference2 is a larger dramatic-lit view of that same mask for sculpt only; its blue light must not become paint. Reference3 shows the separate mask in the blister, reference4 shows it held detached and establishes boundary, not a replacement camera. Copy the main catalog view: nearly frontal, mild downward pitch, tall NARROW proportions (visible shell about177wide×271high, ratio around0.65). Do not widen/shorten it into a generic squat Predator mask. Preserve the tall deep oval forehead dome within its raised brown/rust-edged silver horseshoe rim, the two SHORT top corners and shallow top contour, pale cool gray solid eye lenses under the angular brow, small central nasal bridge, long narrow plain gray central muzzle and the curved parallel blackened channels along cheeks and sides of muzzle. Keep the tiny photographed copper/rust-rimmed side cheek fittings only, no extra ports or hoses. Actual palette is worn gray/silver with muted brown/rust in recess/rim, modest toy texture; do not make blue, purple, bright gold or all-over chrome. Do not create invented scratches/filigree/letters/glyphs/teeth/horns or decorative etched grain beyond the source. Keep actual solid eye lens material, not living eyes or empty sockets. REMOVE ALL biological head/scalp/mandibles, white skin, every dreadlock/band, neck/collar, armor, shoulder cannon, weapons, hands, trophies, the toy body and catalog/background. Keep ONLY the complete photographed rigid shell. No unseen rear/interior reconstruction or invented alternative angle. ONE whole isolated mask, no duplicate or board, genuine transparent RGBA with no cast floor shadow/text/backdrop. Preserve the source head camera and narrow elongated silhouette. Center the object at about78–80% of canvas height, leaving8–12% EMPTY alpha above the uppermost short rim corners and below the muzzle; generous left/right transparent room. Complete contour unclipped.
